game.name: Ashes Cricket 2009 (Europe)
game.desc: Ashes Cricket 2009 for Xbox 360 is a sports game that lets you replay a major cricket competition, the Ashes, which pits England against Australia every year. The competition consists of a series of five test matches. The game faithfully reproduces the world's most famous stadiums and will feature the Ashes mode, in addition to other more common modes.
